messages:
maya: Quick sync — Silverpine QBR prep. Account health mostly green but token run-rate jumped ~3x after their embed rollout. Onboarding is stuck on chunked uploads. Need to align on spend forecast + alerts. @jordan @leo can you join?

jordan: On it. Pulled their usage — embedding traffic peaked ~220M tokens/day, current avg ~95M. With their product roadmap +20% m/m growth, our forecast shows runway hitting critical in ~6 weeks unless we apply guardrails.

leo: Ok. Recommend: soft throttle + alerting. Set warn at 60% committed credits, critical at 80%. Soft throttle policy: reduce embeddings concurrency and enable prefix caching. That should shave ~25-35% off duplicate calls.

sam: Enablement note — onboarding blocked by client batching logic. I can land a small client patch tomorrow that reduces tokens per upload ~30% by coalescing chunks and deduping metadata.

maya: Great. Action items: 1) Sam — patch client by Tue. 2) Leo — draft budget alert + soft-throttle policy. 3) Jordan — update forecast with +20% growth scenario and a mitigated scenario (with caching + patch). 4) I'll capture feedback & make a 1-pager cost playbook for the QBR. Also need a short customer-facing slide on expected impact.

leo: Drafting now. Quick rule snippet for alerting I plan to propose:
```
# pseudo-rule
alert: credits_warn
if credit_util >= 0.6 then notify # email + slack -> cs-oncall
alert: credits_critical
if credit_util >= 0.8 then engage soft_throttle(policy=reduce_parallelism to 8)
```
Estimates: warn->critical transition window ~48-72h at current burn.

jordan: Sharing internal forecast link: https://redwood.app/silverpine-qbr-forecast (internal). Sheets: baseline / optimistic (with optimizations) / pessimistic. I'll attach expected monthly token burn and runway weeks per scenario.

ashley: Heads-up — renewal conversation scheduled ~8 weeks out. If we can demonstrate a steady decline in burn post-patch + caching, we should avoid deeper discount asks. If not, they'll push for price protections.

maya: Good call. Let's lock a 30m prep: tomorrow 10am PT. Thumbs up if you can.

jordan: :thumbsup:

sam: :+1:

leo: I'll be there and will bring the alert config + sample metric graphs.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder — production client patch scheduled for 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC if PR merges.

maya: Copy. I'll draft the QBR bullets and a short appendix: 'Silverpine cost playbook' with quick wins (client patch, prefix caching, soft throttle) and expected impact ranges.
